{{Top}}
The '''Republic Central Medcenter''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the size of a small [[City/Legends|city]] with its own traffic system. It had a dedicated [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] connecting it with the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Halls of Healing|infirmary]], used by the most desperate of patients. It had a [[Unidentified Republic Central Medcenter chief executive|chief executive]] in charge of its operations.<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

While he was in a [[Coma/Legends|coma]], [[Omega Squad]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Fi Skirata]] was treated in its [[Republic Central Medcenter neurology unit|neurology unit]] for a short while. When he was scheduled to be euthanized, [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] agent [[Besany Wennen]] started an [[Standoff in the Republic Central Medcenter|armed siege]] in order to protect him. The situation was defused when [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] arrived with [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] personnel and took Fi safely to his [[Jaller Obrim's residence|home]] for continued treatment.<ref name="tc" />
